messages.text: I’ll trace the completed muon measurements back to the raw inputs and diagnostics, then check the crossing counts, fits, uncertainty treatment and SNR.

I118-NODD-PhysVal-MuonData completed at **c9f2fa7992391987a46c81f038623a2d14e79990**. **No consequential finding.** The numerical μ evidence supports the scoped plots; figures remain unreviewed.

Verified summary SHA: `59540ebdbacff877d01691516120e2687a112692092f48bc6ff4ed0b10f7c44b`. All six assigned sources and three assigned artifact hashes remained unchanged.

Each population contains 250 events and 12,000 nominal depth opportunities:

| Geometry | η | Identified | Unknown crossing | PN >0.6 MIP | Qualified spectrum |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| nODD | 0 | 10,513 | 1,487 | 10,474 | 8,725 |
| nODD | +2 | 10,704 | 1,296 | 10,658 | 8,515 |
| nODD | −2 | 10,698 | 1,302 | 10,657 | 8,460 |
| ODD zero field | 0 | 12,000 | 0 | 11,964 | 10,462 |
| ODD zero field | +2 | 12,000 | 0 | 11,972 | 10,483 |

Actual independent checks:

- Closed raw/native receipts, binaries, backend, configurations, helpers, source hashes, six canonical population bindings and completion metadata verified.
- Reconstructed all **1,500 raw events / 74,767 ECAL hit references**, including primary object endpoints, contamination, split depths, immediate constructed neighbours, chord selection and native position references.
- Matched all **18 unthresholded and 12 thresholded spectra**, quantiles, path statistics, threshold counts and monotonicity. Both 2,304-plane inventories/crosswalks closed; maximum position residual was **0.000195313 mm**, below 0.002 mm.
- Independently reproduced all 1,000-resample yield/category uncertainties and covariance matrices. Split-category undefined counts **1000/7/128/1000/142/7** correctly retain null bootstrap errors.
- Replayed all **18 central ROOT fits** exactly, including curves, covariance and deviance. No near-bound parameters; diagnostic p-values span **0.3346–0.9347**.
- Repeated the complete **1,000-fit nODD η0 PN bootstrap**: zero failures; MPV SE **0.00304096484**, CI95 **[0.951576129, 0.963625267]**, matching the summary.
- Recomputed the shared 200,000-value pedestal: SD **0.130119248 MIP**, mean **−0.0000504523 MIP**, **4,610** above 2σ and zero above 0.6 MIP. All analytic Gaussian deviations are below 0.9 standard errors. SNR calculations reproduce **7.360–7.429**.

Keep the interpretation explicit: nODD’s missing deposits are **unknown transported crossings**, so nominal yields are not measured electronic inefficiency. Fits and SNR characterize the selected, approximately path-normalized population; they exclude geometry/model systematics and detector occupancy.

Checks used `software/env/run.sh python3 -B` with the three scratch scripts/results at `/private/tmp/nodd-physval-muon-{audit,fits,additional}.{py,json}`. No repository edits, geometry execution or transport occurred; no authored outcome report was read. Full shower and original-Key4hep comparisons remain pending.
